If you complete these 10 videos, you will master SQL Window functions!

session 1 - Group By Vs Window Functions | Partition By & Order By Clause
https://lnkd.in/gV_pWiW4

session 2 - ROW NUMBER with Example Use-case
https://lnkd.in/gDbPhv5F

session 3 - RANK Vs DENSE_RANK Vs ROW_NUMBER
https://lnkd.in/gf7mq-5Q

session 4 - LEAD & LAG Functions
https://lnkd.in/gXvkTvW8

session 5 - Window Aggregate Functions Part 1 
https://lnkd.in/gDVFM_BR

session 6 - Window Aggregate Functions Part-2
https://lnkd.in/gxb8vCNW

session 7 - 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐞𝐰 𝐐𝐮𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐁𝐢𝐠𝐠𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐝𝐨𝐰 𝐛𝐞𝐭𝐰𝐞𝐞𝐧 𝐕𝐢𝐬𝐢𝐭𝐬 (𝐌𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐮𝐦)
https://lnkd.in/g5_WsWH9

session 8 - 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐞𝐰 𝐐𝐮𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐓𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐧𝐚𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐬 (𝐇𝐚𝐫𝐝)
https://lnkd.in/gdHhrtSm

session 9 - 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐞𝐰 𝐐𝐮𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐋𝐨𝐧𝐠𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐒𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐤 (𝐇𝐚𝐫𝐝)
https://lnkd.in/gUCZuC_U

session 10 - 𝐈𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐢𝐞𝐰 𝐐𝐮𝐞𝐬𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐓𝐨𝐩 𝐓𝐡𝐫𝐞𝐞 𝐖𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐬 (𝐇𝐚𝐫𝐝)
https://lnkd.in/gbKcCNCb

If some watches this window functions playlist whole heartedly, you wont have to go through any other piece of content. It's so much in depth.

I am sure you will enjoy this learning experience!

The session titles identify coverage of GROUP BY versus window functions, PARTITION BY and ORDER BY, ROW_NUMBER, RANK, DENSE_RANK, LEAD, LAG, window aggregate functions, and medium-to-hard SQL interview questions. The post does not include technical explanations, examples, or extracted media text beyond the playlist titles and links.
